values.meaning: Mantra cooldown reduction per enemy champion hit by a Karma damaging ability
values.quote: ''{{ais|Mantra|Karma}}'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 4 seconds for each enemy champion hit

mechanics.claim: Inner Flame / Soulflare can each independently reduce Mantra's cooldown per champion hit, up to a maximum total reduction of 40 seconds if 5 enemy champions are hit by both damage instances.
mechanics.quote: reduces {{ais|Mantra|Karma}} cooldown per champion hit by either damage instance (up to a maximum total reduction of {{ap|4*10}} seconds if 5 enemy champions are hit by both instances of damage)

mechanics.claim: Focused Resolve / Renewal reduces Mantra's cooldown twice: once on initial cast and again when the tether expires, for a total reduction of 8 seconds.
mechanics.quote: reduces {{ais|Mantra|Karma}} cooldown when initially cast and again after the duration for the tether has expired (for a total reduction of {{ap|4*2}} seconds)

mechanics.claim: The cooldown reduction applies to Mantra's current (remaining) cooldown.
